title: Invocation and Exorcism
english: We call upon you, all-powerful Lord Jesus Christ, heavenly king.
We call upon you who made heaven and earth.
I exorcise you, unclean spirit, by the word of God who made heaven and earth.
Fear the light held back as a garment.
The only one possessing immortality and unapproachable light.
To whom glory and power belong into the ages.
baehrens: PG 41-43; Fragmenta precationis et exorcismi (Khazarzar) u01 open
